title: Application are invited for 34th Skill Development Programme on Pharmacovigilance scheduled from 18th to 22nd August 2025.
bodyHtml:
Application are invited for 34th Skill Development Programme on Pharmacovigilance scheduled from 18th to 22nd August 2025.
Mode: Online
Registration Fee: Rs. 2000/-
Last Date of Registration: 12th August 2025
Organized By: National Coordination Centre- Pharmacovigilance Programme of India, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission
Online payment Link: https://payments.cashfree.com/forms/34SDPPVPI (opens in a new tab)
(opens in a new tab)
